description: This Java source file defines the RetrieveThingStrategy class, which handles the retrieval strategy for 'Thing' entities within a persistence and command execution framework. It manages how 'RetrieveThing' commands are executed, checking if the command is applicable, generating retrieval results, and managing entity tags.

classes.name: RetrieveThingStrategy
classes.description: A final class that implements a retrieval strategy for 'RetrieveThing' commands, extending AbstractThingCommandStrategy, handling execution logic, response creation, and entity tag management.

methods.name: RetrieveThingStrategy
methods.description: Constructor initializing the strategy with the RetrieveThing class type.

methods.name: isDefined
methods.description: Checks whether the strategy applies based on context, existing thing, and command, primarily verifying the entity ID matches the context state and the entity is not deleted.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the retrieval logic, producing a result containing the retrieved 'Thing' data or an inaccessible indicator.

methods.name: getRetrieveThingResponse
methods.description: Constructs the response headers and JSON payload for the retrieved 'Thing' or indicates inaccessibility.

methods.name: getThingJson
methods.description: Serializes the 'Thing' object to JSON using the requested schema version and selected fields.

methods.name: notAccessible
methods.description: Creates a 'ThingNotAccessibleException' for an inaccessibility scenario.

methods.name: unhandled
methods.description: Generates an error result if the retrieval command cannot be handled, indicating inaccessibility.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the entity tag of the previous 'Thing' if available.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Generates the next entity tag based on the new 'Thing' entity.
